استغفلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَلُوا (istaḡfalū) /is.taɣ.fa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اُسْتُغْفِلُوا (ustuḡfilū) /us.tuɣ.fi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اِسْتَغْفِلُوا (istaḡfilū) /is.taɣ.fi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
